idea-plugin.name: Lotus Islands Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Lotus Islands Theme

A Lotus-derived color scheme built specifically for the new JetBrains Islands UI (2025.3+), with improved contrast and accessibility, and a consistent set of primary colors within a unified design system.

Includes both a dark and a light theme:

  • Lotus Islands Dark
  • Lotus Islands Light

Original color palette based from the Lotus Theme by Brian Lai.
